item.title: New release—"About Chronologue Relay P2P Protocols"
item.description:
I’m pleased to share the publication of a new concept document:

  • “About Chronologue Relay P2P Protocols,” on the Chronologue documentation site

This doc shipped as part of The Good Docs Project’s Iron Release (1.6):

  • The Good Docs Project’s Iron release announcement

It models the The Good Docs Project’s Concept template in action. Access the template in GitLab:

  • Core documentation template pack
